content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OrderToCash"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/order-to-cash"
                  exporter="Mastra Code"
                  exporterVersion="1.0">

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderToCash" name="Order-to-Cash" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_OrderToCash">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sales" name="Sales">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ValidateOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderValid</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyInvalidOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderRejectedInvalid</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateBackorder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickAndPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShipOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Finance">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCredit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CreditApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestPrepayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderRejectedCredit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendInvoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitForPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_PaymentTimeout</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendPaymentReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Sales -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToValidate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ValidateOrder" name="Validate order data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToValidate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ValidateToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderValid" name="Order valid?" default="Flow_OrderInvalid">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ValidateToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderInvalid</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderValid</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyInvalidOrder" name="Notify customer: order invalid">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderInvalid</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyInvalidToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderRejectedInvalid" name="Order rejected (invalid)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyInvalidToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Finance: credit check -->
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="Task_CheckCredit" name="Check customer credit rating">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderValid</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditChecked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:businessRuleTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CreditApproved" name="Credit approved?" default="Flow_CreditRejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditChecked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestPrepayment" name="Request prepayment from customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditRejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepaymentToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderRejectedCredit" name="Order not accepted (credit)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepaymentToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Warehouse: inventory and fulfilment -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckInventory" name="Check inventory availability">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BackorderLoop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InventoryChecked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock" name="Items in stock?" default="Flow_OutOfStock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InventoryChecked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OutOfStock</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateBackorder" name="Create backorder and inform customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OutOfStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BackorderLoop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PickAndPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Picked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ShipOrder" name="Ship order to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Picked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Shipped</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <!-- Finance: invoicing and payment -->
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvoice" name="Send invoice to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Shipped</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InvoiceSent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitForPayment" name="Wait for payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InvoiceSent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReminderSent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentReceived</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_PaymentTimeout" name="Payment overdue (14 days)"
                        attachedToRef="Task_WaitForPayment" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentOverdue</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_PaymentTimeout">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P14D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentReminder" name="Send payment reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentOverdue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReminderSent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordPayment" name="Record payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentReceived</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentRecorded</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order fulfilled and paid">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentRecorded</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToValidate" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_ValidateOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ValidateToCheck" sourceRef="Task_ValidateOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderValid" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderInvalid" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderValid" targetRef="Task_NotifyInvalidOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyInvalidToEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyInvalidOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderRejectedInvalid" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderValid" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderValid" targetRef="Task_CheckCredit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${orderValid == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditChecked" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredit" targetRef="Gateway_CreditApproved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditRejected" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_CreditApproved" targetRef="Task_RequestPrepayment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepaymentToEnd" sourceRef="Task_RequestPrepayment" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderRejectedCredit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditApproved" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CreditApproved" targetRef="Task_CheckInventory">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${creditApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InventoryChecked" sourceRef="Task_CheckInventory" targetRef="Gateway_InStock" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutOfStock" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_CreateBackorder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BackorderLoop" sourceRef="Task_CreateBackorder" targetRef="Task_CheckInventory" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${itemsInStock == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Picked" sourceRef="Task_PickAndPack" targetRef="Task_ShipOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shipped" sourceRef="Task_ShipOrder" targetRef="Task_SendInvoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvoiceSent" sourceRef="Task_SendInvoice" targetRef="Task_WaitForPayment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received" sourceRef="Task_WaitForPayment" targetRef="Task_RecordPayment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentOverdue" name="No payment within 14 days" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_PaymentTimeout" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentReminder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderSent" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentReminder" targetRef="Task_WaitForPayment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentRecorded" sourceRef="Task_RecordPayment" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" />

  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_OrderToCash">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_OrderToCash" bpmnElement="Process_OrderToCash">

      <!-- Pool and lanes -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Pool_OrderToCash" bpmnElement="Process_OrderToCash" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="160" y="80" width="1780" height="660" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Lane_Sales" bpmnElement="Lane_Sales" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="190" y="80" width="1750" height="220" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Lane_Warehouse" bpmnElement="Lane_Warehouse" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="190" y="300" width="1750" height="220" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Lane_Finance" bpmnElement="Lane_Finance" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="190" y="520" width="1750" height="220" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Sales shapes -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_StartEvent_OrderReceived" bpmnElement="StartEvent_OrderReceived">
        <dc:Bounds x="250" y="212" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_ValidateOrder" bpmnElement="Task_ValidateOrder">
        <dc:Bounds x="336" y="190" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Gateway_OrderValid" bpmnElement="Gateway_OrderValid" isMarkerVisible="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="486" y="205" width="50" height="50" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_NotifyInvalidOrder" bpmnElement="Task_NotifyInvalidOrder">
        <dc:Bounds x="586" y="100" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_EndEvent_OrderRejectedInvalid" bpmnElement="EndEvent_OrderRejectedInvalid">
        <dc:Bounds x="736" y="122" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Warehouse shapes -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_CheckInventory" bpmnElement="Task_CheckInventory">
        <dc:Bounds x="836" y="410" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Gateway_InStock" bpmnElement="Gateway_InStock" isMarkerVisible="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="986" y="425" width="50" height="50" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_CreateBackorder" bpmnElement="Task_CreateBackorder">
        <dc:Bounds x="1086" y="310" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_PickAndPack" bpmnElement="Task_PickAndPack">
        <dc:Bounds x="1086" y="410" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_ShipOrder" bpmnElement="Task_ShipOrder">
        <dc:Bounds x="1236" y="410" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Finance shapes -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_CheckCredit" bpmnElement="Task_CheckCredit">
        <dc:Bounds x="586" y="630" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Gateway_CreditApproved" bpmnElement="Gateway_CreditApproved" isMarkerVisible="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="736" y="645" width="50" height="50" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_RequestPrepayment" bpmnElement="Task_RequestPrepayment">
        <dc:Bounds x="836" y="540" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_EndEvent_OrderRejectedCredit" bpmnElement="EndEvent_OrderRejectedCredit">
        <dc:Bounds x="986" y="562" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_SendInvoice" bpmnElement="Task_SendInvoice">
        <dc:Bounds x="1386" y="630" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_WaitForPayment" bpmnElement="Task_WaitForPayment">
        <dc:Bounds x="1536" y="630" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_BoundaryEvent_PaymentTimeout" bpmnElement="BoundaryEvent_PaymentTimeout">
        <dc:Bounds x="1568" y="612" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_SendPaymentReminder" bpmnElement="Task_SendPaymentReminder">
        <dc:Bounds x="1636" y="540" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_RecordPayment" bpmnElement="Task_RecordPayment">
        <dc:Bounds x="1686" y="630" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_EndEvent_OrderCompleted" bpmnElement="EndEvent_OrderCompleted">
        <dc:Bounds x="1836" y="652" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Edges -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_StartToValidate" bpmnElement="Flow_StartToValidate">
        <di:waypoint x="286" y="230" />
        <di:waypoint x="336" y="230" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_ValidateToCheck" bpmnElement="Flow_ValidateToCheck">
        <di:waypoint x="436" y="230" />
        <di:waypoint x="486" y="230" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_OrderInvalid" bpmnElement="Flow_OrderInvalid">
        <di:waypoint x="511" y="205" />
        <di:waypoint x="511" y="140" />
        <di:waypoint x="586" y="140" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_NotifyInvalidToEnd" bpmnElement="Flow_NotifyInvalidToEnd">
        <di:waypoint x="686" y="140" />
        <di:waypoint x="736" y="140" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_OrderValid" bpmnElement="Flow_OrderValid">
        <di:waypoint x="536" y="230" />
        <di:waypoint x="561" y="230" />
        <di:waypoint x="561" y="670" />
        <di:waypoint x="586" y="670" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_CreditChecked" bpmnElement="Flow_CreditChecked">
        <di:waypoint x="686" y="670" />
        <di:waypoint x="736" y="670" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_CreditRejected" bpmnElement="Flow_CreditRejected">
        <di:waypoint x="761" y="645" />
        <di:waypoint x="761" y="580" />
        <di:waypoint x="836" y="580" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_PrepaymentToEnd" bpmnElement="Flow_PrepaymentToEnd">
        <di:waypoint x="936" y="580" />
        <di:waypoint x="986" y="580" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_CreditApproved" bpmnElement="Flow_CreditApproved">
        <di:waypoint x="786" y="670" />
        <di:waypoint x="811" y="670" />
        <di:waypoint x="811" y="450" />
        <di:waypoint x="836" y="450" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_InventoryChecked" bpmnElement="Flow_InventoryChecked">
        <di:waypoint x="936" y="450" />
        <di:waypoint x="986" y="450" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_OutOfStock" bpmnElement="Flow_OutOfStock">
        <di:waypoint x="1011" y="425" />
        <di:waypoint x="1011" y="350" />
        <di:waypoint x="1086" y="350" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_BackorderLoop" bpmnElement="Flow_BackorderLoop">
        <di:waypoint x="1086" y="370" />
        <di:waypoint x="886" y="370" />
        <di:waypoint x="886" y="410" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_InStock" bpmnElement="Flow_InStock">
        <di:waypoint x="1011" y="475" />
        <di:waypoint x="1061" y="475" />
        <di:waypoint x="1061" y="450" />
        <di:waypoint x="1086" y="450" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_Picked" bpmnElement="Flow_Picked">
        <di:waypoint x="1186" y="450" />
        <di:waypoint x="1236" y="450" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_Shipped" bpmnElement="Flow_Shipped">
        <di:waypoint x="1336" y="450" />
        <di:waypoint x="1361" y="450" />
        <di:waypoint x="1361" y="670" />
        <di:waypoint x="1386" y="670" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_InvoiceSent" bpmnElement="Flow_InvoiceSent">
        <di:waypoint x="1486" y="670" />
        <di:waypoint x="1536" y="670" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_PaymentReceived" bpmnElement="Flow_PaymentReceived">
        <di:waypoint x="1636" y="670" />
        <di:waypoint x="1686" y="670" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_PaymentOverdue" bpmnElement="Flow_PaymentOverdue">
        <di:waypoint x="1586" y="612" />
        <di:waypoint x="1586" y="580" />
        <di:waypoint x="1636" y="580" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_ReminderSent" bpmnElement="Flow_ReminderSent">
        <di:waypoint x="1686" y="540" />
        <di:waypoint x="1686" y="510" />
        <di:waypoint x="1550" y="510" />
        <di:waypoint x="1550" y="630" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_PaymentRecorded" bpmnElement="Flow_PaymentRecorded">
        <di:waypoint x="1786" y="670" />
        <di:waypoint x="1836" y="670" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
